format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

leaders <- read_csv("data/wnba_leaders_2025.csv")
top_players <- read_csv("data/wnba_top_players_2025.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: player-comparison-plot
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 18
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-dpi: 300

player_order <- top_players |> 
  arrange(Points) |> 
  pull(player)

stats_long <- top_players |>
  mutate(
    `Field Goal %` = `Field Goal Pct` * 100,
    player = factor(player, levels = player_order)
  ) |>
  select(-`Field Goal Pct`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Points, Rebounds, Assists, Steals, Blocks, `Field Goal %`, Minutes),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c(
      "Points", "Rebounds", "Assists", 
      "Steals", "Blocks", "Field Goal %", "Minutes"
    ))
  )

stats_long |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = player, fill = player)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 WNBA Season Comparison: Top 12 Scorers",
    subtitle = "Per game averages and shooting percentage across key statistical categories",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Basketball Reference (2025 Season)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey30"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines")
  )
```
